summary: P1-P11 are all merged and I can point at implementing work for every one of V01-V22: V01-V09 to the ArgoCDTools tree and its live proofs, V12/V13 to Charts 0.2.0 and its render/publish gates, V15/V16/V18 to attachments/credential-inventory.md, V17 to P6's single iac/tf-backend grant, V20-V22 to P7/P8, and V10/V11 to the test phase plus the already-carded operator prerequisites. Generation 1's three appended phases (P9/P10/P11) all signed off, leaving only Minor advisory findings, and I re-checked the two hinges those phases turned on rather than trusting their records: the shipped chart template renders four required-guarded args plus envFrom on argocd-hook-credentials, and every environment name presync requires (GIT_USERNAME, GITHUB_TOKEN, the TF_BACKEND_HTTP_*/SOPS_AGE_KEY trio) is in the inventory, whose provider set matches _providers/providers.tf. Nothing outstanding clears the blocking bar; the two doc-prose residues from P11's review I fixed and committed in this session (AnsibleSpecs c0819e5).
cards: [consult r2] Charts' render gate locates the args: block with an awk latch on the render's first args:, with nothing tying it to the hook Job (P10 r1 F1). A future fixture manifest that helm sorts ahead of the Job and carries its own args: makes tests/render-consumer.sh fail claiming the hook renders the wrong arguments — a misleading false red, never a false green.

[consult r2] presync exports an empty stage or namespace argument verbatim as an empty TF_VAR_* (P9 r1 F1), reproducing the silent misnaming P9 closes. Unreachable from a rendered Job — Helm's required rejects the empty string too — so the chart's guard is the whole of the protection.
